_about: STYLE CLIPS (2026-09-15): owner "add more dynamic moves like 360 hook kicks, capoeira like movements like youre break dancing if you choose that style, advanced taekwando and tricking, parkour". CMU subjects 85/87/88/90 (downloaded with approval), 75/127 (from zips on disk). Windows chosen off scripts/mocap/take-events.mts + take-timeline.mts. Every clip carries a ROOT TRACK (the pelvis turns over). replaces = the base clip name a fight mode requests; style = the vocabulary. · 2026-09-15 review: the 'monkey sequence' kicks (cap_meia_lua / cap_queixada / cap_martelo) and trick_high_kick were dropped — the capture is a crouched ape walk, they read as crawling; the light links borrow the clean karate captures (styleMotion STYLE_BORROWS).
